I've replied to Pree in your DM (DSHARED0001). On 14 October she told me her cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October from now on.

**gbrain refused to read the note:** I couldn't get her saved note back from gbrain. It turned the lookup down because this connection isn't tied to any member, and the brain is shared by several people. So I took the date from her own 14 October message in that DM, which she can see herself.

To make gbrain lookups work, whoever runs the gbrain server needs to tie this connection to a member. gbrain suggests `gbrain auth rescope --member <MEMBER>`; the full command it gave includes the access token. Because the bot works for many people, the server admin may prefer gbrain's option of listing the members it acts for and naming the member on each lookup. I haven't changed any gbrain access settings.
